entries.summary: Mirage maps IsEnabled explicitly so input/read-only/search/clear interactivity remains deterministic across browser runtimes.
Mirage currently projects cancel/search icon color channels to clear/search button text color on the browser host rather than native platform icon glyph channels.
Mirage keeps DOM input type as search and varies inputmode for keyboard hints so browser keyboard-submit continues to emit the search event across keyboard modes.
